## CallAuditContext.approvalId property

Correlation id for the approval request this call would raise, generated by the caller \*before\* enforcement so that the `pending` record and the later `approved`<!-- -->/`rejected` record can be paired.

Without it, two identical overlapping calls from the same key produce indistinguishable records and an audit consumer cannot tell which resolution belongs to which hold.

[enforceCall()](./core.enforcecall.md) records it \*\*only\*\* on a `pending` decision — an `allowed` or `denied` call never raises an approval request, so carrying the id there would be noise. [recordApprovalDecision()](./core.recordapprovaldecision.md) always records it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly approvalId?: string | undefined;
```
